AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 3, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL
   Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with the
  Norwalk Association of Management Employees.

  II.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with the
  Norwalk City Employees Association.

  III.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8045-008-902; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: State of California; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

  IV.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8082-013-905; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: Department of the Air Force; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of
  Payment.

  V.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION  PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE 54956.9(d)(4): Initiation of litigation in one case.

  VI. PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957(b)(1); TITLE: CITY
  ATTORNEY.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

INVOCATION
  Danny Casas, Assistant Executive Pastor
  New Harvest Christian Fellowship Church

FLAG SALUTE
  Ameni Serrano
  Norwalk High School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize Hometown Heroes.

  II.  City Council to recognize Norma Sifuentes for her retirement.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  Norwalk Headstart Project Highlights.
   2.  Public Safety BBQ highlights.

  3.  Norwalk Census Campaign, Summer Activities Summary.

  4.  City Launches “Norwalk Connects” Citizen Inquiry App.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of August
  20 and 27, 2019. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period July 28, 2019 – August
  10, 2019, in the total amount of $1,004,675.07. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  August 14 – August 27, 2019, in the total amount of $3,004,417.58. 640

  Report

  4.  APPROVE SELECTION OF PERSONNEL APPEALS BOARD MEMBERS FOR UPCOMING APPEAL
  HEARING - Staff recommends City Council approve the Mayor’s Personnel Appeals Board selections
  of Kim Apodaca, Gloria Rodriguez, and Richard Sneed. 255-01

  Report

  5.  CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION –
  HERMOSILLO PARK GRANT APPLICATION - Staff recommends City Council authorize filing of the
  Notice of Categorical Exemption with the County of Los Angeles for the Hermosillo Park grant
  application. 623

  Report

  6.  AGREEMENT FOR WATER METER READING AND RELATED SERVICES FOR THE NORWALK
  MUNICIPAL WATER SYSTEM WITHIN THE CITY OF ARTESIA - Staff recommends City Council
  approve an agreement with Precision Pipeline, Inc. in the amount of $50,000 for water meter reading
  and related services for the Norwalk Municipal Water System within the City of Artesia for the term of
  July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020; with the option to extend for two (2) additional one (1) year
  periods; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments or extensions
  provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.
  1070-05

  Report

  7.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-52 – APPOINTMENT TO SERVE AS THE CITY’S ALTERNATE VOTING
  DELEGATE AT THE ANNUAL LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES CONFERENCE AND BUSINESS
  MEETING - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-52, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK DESIGNATING JESUS M. GOMEZ AS THE CITY’S
  ALTERNATE VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE ANNUAL LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES
  CONFERENCE AND BUSINESS MEETING TO BE HELD OCTOBER 16-18, 2019. 130-04

  Report

  8.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-53 – AMENDING FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 SALARY SCHEDULE – Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-53, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
   THE CITY OF NORWALK AMENDING THE SALARY SCHEDULE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 FOR
  GENERAL, HOURLY, AND MANAGEMENT UNIT EMPLOYEES.

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  9.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200 RESOLUTION

  Report

REPORTS

  10. RESOLUTION NO. 19-51 – APPROVING THE ACQUISITION OF A LOS ANGELES COUNTY TAX-
  DEFAULTED PROPERTY LOCATED AT 11850 CREWE STREET, NORWALK, CA 90650
  (ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NUMBER 8024-019-008) - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution
  No. 19-51, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF NORWALK APPROVING THE ACQUISITION
  OF A LOS ANGELES COUNTY TAX-DEFAULTED PROPERTY LOCATED AT 11850 CREWE
  STREET, NORWALK, CA 90650 (ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NUMBER 8024-019-008); and authorize the
  City Manager to execute the agreement, any amendments, and documents for the Chapter 8
  Agreement Sale, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 905-07

  Report

  11. LEGISLATIVE REPORT UPDATE - POSITIONS ON LEGISLATIVE BILLS - Staff recommends City
  Council take the following positions and direct staff to proceed with communicating the City's position
  on each bill to the League of California Cities and State legislators:

  a. Support ACA 1 - Supported by the League
  b. Support SB 54 - Supported by the League
  c. Oppose AB 516 - Opposed by the League
  d. Oppose SB 330 - Opposed by the League
  e. Oppose SB 592 - Opposed by the League
  f. Oppose AB 1763 - Opposed by the League
  g. Oppose SB 266 - Opposed by the League  850

  Report

  12. LIGHT EMITTING DIODE (LED) OPTION E ENERGY RATE - Staff recommends City Council approve
  the Option E agreement with Southern California Edison to install LED fixtures on approximately 1,500
  street light poles; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1060-01-01

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated November 30, -1.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
